title: Nectarine Elixir Dessert
description: A refreshing summer dessert made with poached nectarines and a light elixir. Perfect for warm weather.
instructions: Butter a 9-inch (23cm) pie dish and set aside.
Cut nectarines into wedges and place them on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle granulated sugar over the nectarines and toss to coat.
Bake nectarines for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
Meanwhile, combine elixir, water, lemon juice, and salt in a blender.
Blend until smooth and set aside.
In a separate saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Pour the elixir mixture into the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, until slightly thickened.
To assemble the dessert, place the nectarine wedges in the prepared pie dish.
Drizzle the elixir mixture over the nectarines and serve warm.
